save_checkpoint: save a model checkpoint with optimizer state and config to a .pyth file for later resumption
load_checkpoint: load a model checkpoint from a .pyth file with optional 2D to 3D weight inflation support
load_train_checkpoint: load a training checkpoint to resume training from the last saved epoch or a specified file
load_test_checkpoint: load a test checkpoint from a specified path or the latest checkpoint in the output directory
has_checkpoint: check if a checkpoint directory contains any saved checkpoint files for a given job path
